name: 3D Model Viewer by Arty
author: artyplugin

sections.description:
3D Model Viewer by Arty is the ultimate solution for live 3D model preview in the browser. It is working with following model formats: .3ds, .3mf, .amf, .assimp, .dae, .drc, .fbx, .glb, .gltf, .gcode, .json, .kmz, .obj, .ply, .stl, .zip.

Our 3D Model Viewer is super fast and realistic, guaranteeing smooth performance. Once you install the viewer, you will need to subscribe to Arty platform where you can upload 3D models and link them to products from your shop.

3D Model Viewer by Arty by Arty is built on top of three.js, with cross-browser compatibility in mind. We perform thorough QA and make sure that the library is always up to date.

Features

  • Supported formats: 3ds, .3mf, .amf, .assimp, .dae, .drc, .fbx, .glb, .gltf, .gcode, .json, .kmz, .obj, .ply, .stl, .zip
  • Background color
  • Radial background gradient
  • Background 360° panorama
  • Zoom in and Zoom out limit options
  • Auto rotation speed
  • Cast shadows
  • Shadow blur
  • Fullscreen mode
  • Take a screenshot
  • Help screen
  • Intro animation
  • Size labels

How to use

  • Install 3D Model Viewer by Arty plugin and activate it.
  • Navigate to WooCommerce – Settings – 3D Model Viewer by Arty (tab) from WP Admin Dashboard.
  • Click on button link to subscribe to Arty platform.
  • Once subscribed you will get all your product in Arty platform. Upload your 3D models and link them to your products.
  • Navigate to 3D Model Viewer by Arty > Settings to choose where to display 3D Viewer on your product page.
  • If you want to display 3D model on pages other than product page, you can simply get integration code from Arty platform and paste it anywhere on your website.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install 3D Model Viewer by Arty plugin using the built-in WordPress plugin installer.
    If you download 3D Model Viewer plugin manually, make sure it is uploaded to /wp-content/plugins/
    and activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
    Or follow the steps below:
    Plugins > Add new > Upload plugin > Upload 3d-model-viewer-by-arty.zip > Install Now > Activate Plugin.
